description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no. 2 (approved plans) pursuant to planning permission reference 231073FUL dated 19/03/2025 for 'Conversion of existing building into 6 self-contained flats (Use Class C3) at the upper floors and provision of commercial space at the ground and basement level (Use Class E); excavation to provide a basement level; first floor rear extension; creation of a mezzanine floor; and creation of a mansard roof level. (Following part demolition of the building)'. Variation seeks reduction from 6 self-contained flats to 5 self-contained flats; removal of the basement resulting in 56 square metres of commercial floorspace (no loss at ground floor level); additional door opening at ground floor level fronting the east elevation; revised ground floor layout with adequate cycling and waste storage requirements
